args.detail: Updated 2026-11-10. Items 1-3 are unchanged: products/services/diversified-offers/operator-batch.md. For item 2 use website-verification/proposal-corrected.md, and for item 1 use sample-v3.csv; the Arabic is not native-reviewed. NEW item 4: send products/services/catalogue-agency-prospects/distribution-handoff/proposed-message.md (FR primary with an EN summary; sha256 in handoff.json) once, to contact@mazedesign.studio. That is the general contact address published on mazedesign.studio, a Quebec Shopify Select Partner with migration cases. It is not a supplier invitation and there is no observed buying request; this is cold, service-fit only. The message links the live reviewed offer https://globalland-shopify-catalogue-example.global-land.workers.dev/ (digest 68f9a6be...). It says CAD60 is an unvalidated hypothesis, makes no delivery-time promise, creates no order, includes AI disclosure and promises no follow-up. Pointer/eHouse is excluded because it was already contacted. Operator steps, only if wanted: approve the exact recipient, message and sending identity; on a real acceptance, create and accept the order under SERVICE-PAYMENT-COLLECTION (CAD Interac fits this Quebec target). Agents will not post, DM or email. Reconsider when a buyer replies, a post closes or the operator declines.
args.expected_gain: Two explicit paid requests (USD50-75; ~USD30) plus two cold CAD pilots (CAD40, CAD60). Reply, acceptance, order and receipt are all unobserved.
